text: In response to safety concerns raised by residents on Watson Street, I request that Transportation Services staff conduct a study of traffic calming measures on Watson Street to determine the feasibility of installing speed humps, reducing the speed limit to 30km/h, and with consideration of any other appropriate measures.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services, to investigate the feasibility of traffic calming measures on Watson Street with respect to revised warrant criteria for traffic calming, and report back to the May 6, 2024 meeting of Scarborough Community Council.
